wiki.title: Logan Monson
wiki.extract: Logan James Monson is an American politician. He serves as a Republican member for the 69th district in the Utah House of Representatives since 2025. In the 2024 election he defeated Democrat candidate Davina Smith. Monson was previously a member of the city council and mayor of Blanding in San Juan County.
